title: Several wits/grace checks with identical odds needed 2-3 retries before succeeding with no new information or changed circumstance offered between attempts (e.g. the wind-carving check at the Old Watchtower failed twice before succeeding on a nat 20; the water-verse check at the Sunken Shrine failed twice before succeeding). Clearly signposted as retryable, but it reads oddly that persistence alone - not a new approach - is what works.
where: Old Watchtower and Sunken Shrine, the Vale of Ash
